# Blue marlin 4×4 production sprite prompts

Generation: built-in image_gen; user-authorized override of the repo's Higgsfield-only rule. These supersede the earlier 2×2 drafts.

## Standard sixteen-frame sheet

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 16-FRAME MARLIN FISH ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for an arcade game.
Use the input image for fish design and rendering style only. CHANGE THE LAYOUT to FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS. Exactly 16 complete left-facing blue marlin sprites, one sprite per equal cell, on one SQUARE sheet. NO 2x2 sheets and NO strips. The entire sheet is a precise 4 by 4 arrangement, exactly sixteen cells read left-to-right then top-to-bottom.
These must be SIXTEEN DIFFERENT consecutive hand-drawn animation poses of ONE swimming/flight cycle. Keep the bill tip, eye and body center at a consistent registration within every cell and the body length the same; do not rotate the whole sprite or change the camera. Animate the tail and fins through one complete 16-stage undulation: frames1-4 tail eases upward,5-8 tail curls down through neutral,9-12 tail sweeps downward,13-16 tail rises back to neutral. The large blue sail dorsal fin and lower fins bend in complementary successive stages. The angular cyan wake behind the tail changes along the same motion. Each frame must have a genuinely distinct pose and silhouette, not repeated static copies. The fish is electric blue with silver scale belly, narrow gold/yellow side stripe, yellow eye, long pointed bill, tall sail fin and forked tail, exactly matching the reference identity. Strong dark outlines, detailed high quality crisp arcade pixel clusters, clean polished metal-like scale shading.
Background: absolutely FLAT opaque HOT MAGENTA #FF00FF everywhere empty, including holes. No gradient, shadow, halo, motion blur, grid lines, numbers, text, labels or borders. No extra objects, robots or wizards. Every complete fish including entire bill, fins, tail and cyan wake must fit INSIDE its own cell with generous magenta margin on ALL sides. No subject touches a cell border. Each fish plus wake occupies at most80%of its cell width. Frame alignment and consistent size are vital. Create all16 native drawn frames. Square 2048x2048 requested.

## Heavy sixteen-frame sheet

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production SIXTEEN FRAME HEAVY MARLIN FISH ANIMATION sprite sheet.
The input reference shows a standard blue marlin in a4by4layout. Preserve exactly this4COLUMNSby4ROWS layout: SIXTEEN equal square cells on ONE square sprite sheet. Draw ONE entire heavy blue marlin facing LEFT in each cell, exactly16fish. NO2x2sheet, NOstrip. Read successive animationframes rowmajor: top-left to bottom-right.
Create a deeper-bodied larger HEAVY version of the same reference fish, with fuller/taller cobalt sail dorsal fin, thick silver body with dark scale segment lines, narrow bright yellow side stripe, yellow eye, long sharp blue bill, forked blue tail and broader angular cyan energy wake. Maintain reference quality: rich polished highlights, strong black outlines and deliberate crisp arcadepixel-art clusters.
Draw16genuinely distinct consecutive swimming/flight poses covering ONE complete flowing16framecycle. Keep billtip/eye/bodycenter consistently registered in everycell, fixed bodylengthandscale, entirebodyhorizontal, no camerachange or wholerotation. Tail flexes progressively upward in frames1-4, down through neutral5-8, sweepsdown9-12 and risesback13-16. Dorsalsailandlowerfins flex complementarily and wake shapes evolve coherently. No repeated staticholds or copy-paste frames.
Everyemptyarea is perfectlyFLATopaqueHOTMAGENTA#FF00FF, including finholes. No gradient, shadow, halo, motionblur, text, frame labels, numbers, gridlines or borders. Each fishincludingfullbill,allfins,tailandentirewake stays COMPLETE wellinside its owncell with generous margins ALLsides. Fish+wake occupies at most80%cellwidth. No wizard, robot, extraobject or croppedshape. Square2048x2048requested.
